rationale: A unanimous Court is likely to hold that § 1446(b)(1)’s 30-day deadline is a mandatory claim-processing rule that must be enforced when timely raised under § 1447(c), with no judge-made equitable tolling absent textual authorization. The opinion will rely on Nutraceutical and the negative implication from § 1446’s enumerated triggers/exceptions (and Congress’s express extension language elsewhere) to rebut any Irwin/Holland tolling presumption.
